FIELDS.NAME: Model Makers Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Model Makers Haven specializes in retailing a wide range of hobby and model-building supplies. Our core operations include providing a carefully curated selection of products for enthusiasts ranging from model trains and remote-controlled vehicles to craft supplies and educational kits. We pride ourselves on maintaining a safe and inviting retail environment, adhering strictly to local fire and safety codes, ensuring staff are adequately trained in safety and customer service, and conducting regular inventory audits to effectively manage stock. We also offer instructional workshops and classes, all covered by appropriate professional liability insurance to ensure a safe learning experience for our customers. Our store design features clear aisles, organized displays, and adequate safety equipment, ensuring a pleasant shopping experience while minimizing any risks. Additionally, we prioritize excellent vendor relationships to stock both popular and niche hobby items, guaranteeing our customers have access to the materials they need for their projects.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2024, a small fire originated from an electrical fault in the display area, resulting in damage to inventory amounting to $1,200. The cause was promptly addressed by performing electrical system upgrades and no injuries were reported. The status of the incident is resolved, with all damages covered by the existing insurance policy.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday - Saturday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class: B, Grade: 1, Label: UL Listed Fire Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with fencing around the premises and regular nighttime watchperson patrols.
